an4.190:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde.
an4.190:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
an4.190:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
an4.190:2.1: Apalāpā' yaṃ bhikkhave parisā nippalāpā 'yaṃ bhikkhave parisā suddhā sāre patiṭṭhitā.
an4.190:2.2: Tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho tathārūpā 'yaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.3: yathārūpā parisā dullabhā dassanāya pi lokasmiṃ. Tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho tathārūpā 'yaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.4: yathārūpā parisā āhuneyyo pahuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho tathārūpa 'yaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.5: yathārūpāya parisāya appam pi dinnaṃ bahuṃ hoti bahuṃ dinnaṃ bahutaraṃ. Tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho tathārūpā 'yaṃ bhikkhave parisā
an4.190:2.6: yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanāni pi dassanāya gantuṃ api puṭaṃsenāpi. Tathārūpo ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhusaṅgho. 2.
an4.190:3.1: Santi bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe devappattā viharanti,
an4.190:3.2: santi bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmim bhikkhusaṅghe brahmappattā viharanti,
an4.190:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu devappatto hoti?
an4.190:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati . . .
an4.190:4.3: pe . . . dutiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . . tatiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu devappatto hoti. 4.
an4.190:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu brahmappatto hoti?
an4.190:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā . . . pe . . . pharitvā viharati,
an4.190:5.5: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ, upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an4.190:5.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu brahmappatto hoti. 5.
an4.190:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ānejjappatto hoti?
an4.190:6.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamma paṭighasaññānaṃ nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an4.190:6.3: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇan ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an4.190:6.4: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma n' atthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an4.190:6.5: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.190:6.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ānejjappatto hoti. 6.
an4.190:7.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyappatto hoti.
an4.190:7.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.190:7.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyappatto hotīti. [Tass' uddānaṃ:
